subject.title: feat(ui): add Apps & extensions page to the Control UI

question: Should the Control UI permanently promote the full companion-app and ClawHub ecosystem through a new customizable Apps page and agent-menu entry?
rationale: This is a new user-facing product-discovery surface with durable outbound destinations; the PR body reports content confirmation, but the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit owner handling before merge.

options.title: Approve the Apps surface
options.body: Accept the discovery page as the maintained in-product destination, then rebase or refresh the branch and merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Narrow the promotion scope
options.body: Keep the page but remove or revise destinations that maintainers do not want the Control UI to promote permanently.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR if companion-surface discovery should remain documentation-led rather than part of the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Approve the Apps surface
recommendation.body: Accept the discovery page as the maintained in-product destination, then rebase or refresh the branch and merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s focused commits and stated prior content decisions make steipete the strongest available routing candidate.
